observed_content: Infer seven secret 7x7 rational operators from two input/output observations using a known seven-model dictionary; test each recovered model against three independent held-out states. Operators are identity, right/left cyclic shift, factor-two amplification, symmetric diffusion, biased diffusion, edge-weight defect diffusion.

retrieval_log.result: 50/50 assertions passed; seven uniquely identified dictionary members; all 21 held-out vectors predicted exactly.

claims: Unique identification within finite supplied candidate dictionary
Conservation, constant fixed-point property and rotation equivariance recovered from each selected operator

negative_controls.outcome: Six distinct conservative transformations remain compatible; operator not identifiable
Two probes insufficient in general; full basis of seven states recovers entire 7×7 matrix

limitations: Candidates supplied to inference engine beforehand; not open-ended mathematical discovery
No blind independent external evaluator; hypotheses and test generated in same workflow
No causal link to ROOT0 originality, RH, Navier–Stokes or training exposure
